name: research-skill
description: A research skill for Claude Code: budgeted parallel collection, quote-checked citations, sentence-level verification.

plugins.name: research-team
plugins.description: Researches any subject with parallel budgeted collectors that search past the usual account and cover what surrounds the request, one writer and one verification wave, and returns a short report in which every factual sentence cites evidence whose quote a script has matched against the cached source page and a study is read for what its design carries. Bundles the literature-review skill for academic sources.
